steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and chia seeds together in a jar or bowl.
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least four hours.
Slice the banana on top and drizzle with honey to serve.
Heat the oven to {oven:200}.
Toss the chicken, sweet potato and onion with the oil, paprika, salt and pepper on a large baking tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, add the broccoli, then roast for 15 minutes more, until the chicken reaches {temp:74} in the thickest part.
Heat the oven to {oven:180} and brush the holes of a 12-hole muffin tin with oil.
Divide the spinach, capsicum, spring onions and cheese between the holes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and a little black pepper, then pour over the vegetables.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until puffed and set in the middle and a knife pushed in comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes before lifting them out.
Whisk the eggs with the milk.
Warm the oil in a large frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and stir slowly until they are fully set, with no runny egg left, then take the pan off the heat.
Warm the tortillas briefly so they fold without cracking.
Spoon beans, egg, cheese, spring onions and a little salsa down the middle of each tortilla. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Eat straight away, or cool completely, wrap each one in foil and freeze.
Heat the oven to {oven:180} and line a 12-hole muffin tin with paper cases, or grease it well.
Mash the bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk and oil.
Stir in the oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon until just combined, then fold in the blueberries.
Fill the holes about three-quarters full and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until risen and a skewer pushed into the middle comes out clean.
Cool on a rack. For babies, break into strips or pieces they can hold.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan or wok over high heat. Add the eggs and stir until set, then tip them onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the garlic and the white parts of the spring onions, and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the frozen vegetables and stir-fry for 3 minutes, until hot.
Break up the rice, add it to the pan and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, until steaming hot all the way through.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, egg and spring onion greens.
Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrot and celery gently for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, zucchini and mixed herbs and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender, stirring now and then. Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with Parmesan.
Heat the oven to {oven:200} and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, zucchini, garlic and oregano with your hands until just combined.
Roll into balls about the size of a ping-pong ball, set them on the baking tray and brush with the oil.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until browned, with no pink in the middle, and they reach {temp:74}.
Meanwhile, simmer the tomatoes with the basil for 10 minutes. Add the meatballs and turn them in the sauce.
For toddlers, cut the meatballs into quarters.
Warm the oil in a large pan and cook the onion over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for a minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir to coat it in the spices, then add the tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer, partly covered, for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chicken is tender and reaches {temp:74}.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, season with salt, and serve with rice and coriander.

starter.beef_bean_chili.title: Beef and bean chilli
steps: Warm the oil in a large pan and cook the onion and capsicum over medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and beef and cook, breaking the meat up, until browned with no pink left and it reaches {temp:71}.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin, paprika and tomato paste and cook for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer, partly covered, for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Season with salt and serve with sour cream and cheese.
starter.beef_bean_chili.notes: Freeze for up to three months. For children, use less chilli powder and add heat to adult bowls at the table.

steps: Heat the oven to {oven:200}.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil on a large baking tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Push the potatoes to the sides, add the green beans and salmon, drizzle with the rest of the oil and lay the lemon slices on the salmon.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes more, until the salmon flakes easily and reaches {temp:63} in the thickest part.
Scatter with dill. For toddlers, flake the salmon and check carefully for bones.
